task_description: Integrate photo gallery from tannerdolby/eleventy-photo-gallery into Rita Tomforde portfolio site using @11ty/eleventy-img for responsive image optimization

patterns.template_pattern: Layout via frontmatter (layout: base.njk), Nunjucks for loops
patterns.url_pattern: Use | url filter for all paths (GitHub Pages pathPrefix)

existing_implementations.description: Gallery section exists in index.njk using paintings.json data, but gallery CSS classes are NOT implemented yet

critical_constraints.urlPath: Must include /rita-tomforde/ prefix for GitHub Pages
critical_constraints.image_formats: WebP + JPEG only (no AVIF - too slow)
